purpose: Native IndexedDB key implementation evidence; signed full-inventory verification is pending.
changes: Binding and parent storage share typed key transport and comparison, preserving Date, infinities, UTF-16 strings, binary keys, arrays and canonical signed-zero identity.
Stored Date and lossless strings round-trip; ordinary objects escape internal clone/key tags.
Key-path extraction handles String/Array length and Blob/File intrinsic properties.
Index backfills, writes and cursor updates share entry extraction and key-based duplicate elimination.
Auto-increment ignores Date keys and becomes exhausted after a numeric Infinity key.

reproduction.before: The new storage regression failed because Date keys could not be encoded.
reproduction.after: The same test passes, as do all storage tests and a Browser-context test covering Date/number identity, key ordering, UTF-16 strings, inline Date keys, string-length key paths and generator behavior through parent storage.
reproduction.intermediate_failure: The first implementation changed integer JSON spellings in existing index records. Normalization was corrected to preserve them; the unchanged failing test now passes.

qualification.reason: The last signed full inventory remains 2,930/4,022 at50993c3. Native tests do not establish whole-test gains or complete conformance.
